_comment: C3 RankedResult — Dev B's expected output for the golden incident, stubbed so Dev C can build eval/baselines before B's scorer exists. Ranking: origin first. Node names are otel-demo names (join to the catalog + telemetry.json). D/P are illustrative, but T is computed exactly from anomaly_output.json's first_deviation per spec 2.1: t0=12:04:00, horizon=min(max_delta,60)=40s, T=clamp01(1-(FDT-t0)/horizon) -> product-catalog 1.0, checkout 0.5, frontend 0.0.

candidates.explanation: product-catalog deviated first at t0 (T=1.0), influence flows outward to 2 callers with no incoming anomaly (D=0.91), and 2/2 outgoing edges degraded in order (P=0.92). Role: origin.
checkout deviated 20s after product-catalog — half the 40s subgraph horizon, so T=0.5 (spec 2.1) — with mixed in/out influence (D=0.52). Role: amplifier.
frontend deviated last in the subgraph (40s after t0 -> T=0.0 per spec 2.1), influence flowing inward (D=0.18); it earns its rank via D/P, not time. Role: victim.
